plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a simple off-camp build for boxing with only 1 S&C session per week and extra sparring in the schedule. Week 1 establishes a training max for the primary lower-body lift so percentage work can start cleanly in Weeks 2-4. The main goal of this block is to raise general strength and power without adding too much fatigue, using one focused full-body session each week.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body strength, upper-body support strength, and basic explosive output with low weekly fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep power crisp while managing sparring and boxing volume.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward sharper, faster outputs while keeping enough strength work to hold onto force qualities.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height you can land on quietly and confidently. Reset between reps and keep each jump fast.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if boxes are busy or box landings feel awkward. Jump for height and stick the landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want an even simpler option. Start from a still quarter squat and drive up hard.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then work up to one hard clean set of 3-5 reps. Stop if depth or bracing breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. This establishes your baseline for future percentage work.

substitutionOptions.name: Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if back squat setup is uncomfortable. Stay tall and keep the elbows up.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if available and more comfortable on the shoulders. Keep the torso stacked and brace hard.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log the load and reps from your best top set so the next weeks can be based on a solid baseline.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Drive the elbows back and pause briefly at the top. Use a load that leaves about 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the chest-supported station is taken. Keep the torso steady and pull through the elbow.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a simpler setup. Stay tall and avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you prefer a fixed bar path and have a good spotter.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a lower-skill option. Keep the body straight and move through full range.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Move slowly out, keep the ribs down, and only go as far as you can hold a solid trunk position.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no ab wheel is available. Keep the same slow, controlled range.

substitutionOptions.name: Cable Crunch
